name: Plugged.in Random Number Generator

rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This MCP server provides cryptographically secure random number generation capabilities through Node.js's built-in crypto module, offering seven specialized tools for generating integers, floats, bytes, UUIDs, strings, random choices, and booleans with configurable parameters like ranges, precision, character sets, and probability distributions. Built by VeriTeknik using TypeScript with the Model Context Protocol SDK, it features comprehensive input validation with rate limiting to prevent resource exhaustion, multiple output encodings (hex, base64, binary), support for both standard and compact UUID formats, and security-focused design that uses only cryptographically strong pseudo-random data suitable for security-sensitive applications. The implementation includes Docker support with multiple deployment configurations, comprehensive error handling that doesn't leak system information, and built-in prompts to guide users through random value generation workflows, making it valuable for cryptographic key generation, session token creation, password generation, gaming applications, statistical sampling, and any use case requiring high-quality randomness with security guarantees.
